qualification.details: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. See the official notification (PDF) and the University's Work with DU page for the eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Go to the University website, www.du.ac.in.
Click Work with DU and look under the head "Advertisement - Departments" for the details of Advt. No. R&P/326/2026.
Submit your application online in the prescribed Application Form before the last date.

faq.question: Q1. What are the post codes for these jobs?
faq.answer: Junior Hindi Translator is Post Code ND0601 and Legal Assistant is Post Code ND0602.

faq.question: Q2. Are any of these vacancies reserved for SC, ST, OBC or EWS candidates?
faq.answer: No. All 2 Junior Hindi Translator vacancies and the 1 Legal Assistant vacancy are listed under UR, with 00 shown for SC, ST, OBC and EWS.

faq.question: Q3. Can the deadline fall after 20 November 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. If two weeks from the advertisement's publication in the Employment News ends later than 20 November 2026, that later date applies.

faq.question: Q4. Do both posts have the same pay level?
faq.answer: Yes. Junior Hindi Translator and Legal Assistant are both at Pay Level 06 under the VII CPC.

faq.question: Q5. Where will changes to this advertisement be published?
faq.answer: Any addendum or corrigendum to Advt. No. R&P/326/2026 will be posted on the website only, so check the University website for updates.
